TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi sealed beforefieldinit SKImageReadPixelsResult extends System.Object implements class System.IDisposable

Docs.summary: Holds the pixel data produced by an asynchronous read-pixels or rescale-and-read-pixels operation.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
An instance of this type is passed to the callback of an asynchronous read request such as <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImage.RequestReadPixels(SkiaSharp.SKImageInfo,SkiaSharp.SKRectI,System.Action{SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult})>. The result is only valid for the duration of the callback; to keep the data, copy it out with <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult.ToArray(System.Int32)>, <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult.ToImage>, or <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult.ToBitmap> before the callback returns.
